note: Generated by tools/extract_battle_anims.py from vendor/pokered (do not edit). See docs/battle-anims.md.

doc.animations: index i = animation id i + 1 (wAnimationID). 1-165 are the moves, 166-202 the non-move ids from constants/move_constants.asm (SHOWPIC_ANIM ...), 203 is the pointer after NUM_ATTACK_ANIMS (ZigZagScreenAnim, unused)
doc.animations[].script: asm label of the script (several ids can share one)
doc.animations[].commands: battle_anim commands in order; the script ends at `db -1`
doc.commands[].op: subanim (play a subanimation) | special (call a special-effect routine)
doc.commands[].tileset: animation tileset loaded at OAM tile $31 (0/1 = move_anim_0/1, 2 = trade)
doc.commands[].delay: frames each frame block is held (wSubAnimFrameDelay)
doc.commands[].effect: SE_* id; `routine` is the SpecialEffectPointers target
doc.commands[].sound: null = NO_MOVE (silent); else the MoveSoundTable entry of move `move` (sfx, pitch and tempo modifiers). For GROWL/ROAR (IsCryMove checks wAnimationID) the attacker's cry plays with these modifiers added
doc.moveSounds: MoveSoundTable, index = move id - 1 (166 entries; the last one is past NUM_ATTACKS)
